verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official CLI that lets users work with their Airwallex account directly from the command line, and a probe confirmed the CLI documentation page exists. The evidence is only a one-line description, though, with no detail on commands, authentication or agent-oriented use. Missing for 10: documented command coverage and auth flow, AI/agent-friendly features (e.g. structured/JSON output or a non-interactive mode), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
